verdict.rationale: ADK itself documents deploying agents offline, in local Docker containers, or in any container environment. That lets a user control where agent data physically lives by self-hosting. However, nothing documents explicit region selection or data-residency controls, and any regional choice on Google Cloud would come from the host platform rather than ADK. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration for sessions, artifacts, or memory storage; documentation of where managed deployments store data; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This is a good option if you prefer to run offline or disconnected, or otherwise in a system that has no connection to Google Cloud.
You can manually package your Agent into a container image and then run it in any environment that supports container images.
